top_sector.note: lift = how many times more often the dirtiest hours came from this sector than the wind blew from it. stable_in = share of day-resamples in which the same or a neighbouring sector came out on top.

wind_source: Weather reanalysis (ERA5 via Open-Meteo) for the area around the station. Not measured at the station.

threshold.rule: the dirtiest quarter of hours, compared with the same month and the same hour of the morning

polar.how_to_read: probability[speed band][direction] = share of hours in that cell that were among the dirtiest. Draw as a polar heatmap: angle = where the wind came from, radius = wind speed. Directions are centred on the compass point. Grey out cells with count below min_count.

verdict_rule: stands_out needs the lower end of lift_ci95 at 1.2 or more and stable_in at 0.8 or more. Other verdicts: no_clear_direction, mostly_still_air, not_enough_data.
